timeline.text: My kids wanted to draw with a real tablet, not squint at a tiny phone screen.
The tablet plugs into a phone, but nothing reached the TV in real time.
So phone and TV now talk directly, over WebRTC — like a wire across the room.
Every stroke streams live to the screen, with a backup relay if the link drops.
Now the kids draw with a real tablet on the big screen — for a $30 pen.
